methods.label: Dimensions and paired face areas
methods.explanation: The two views show that the rectangular prism has length 5, width 2, and height 3. Its surface area is \(2\times(5\times3+2\times3+5\times2)=2\times31=62\).
methods.levelReason: Reading dimensions from front and left views fits Grade 9, and summing rectangular face areas uses elementary surface-area knowledge.
